scripts.test:all: for p in design-system auth sdui-renderer form-engine telemetry api-client fe-task fe-shell; do if [ -n "$(find projects/$p -name '*.spec.ts' -print -quit)" ]; then ng test $p --watch=false || exit 1; else echo "[test:all] $p: chưa có tệp *.spec.ts, bỏ qua"; fi; done
scripts.build:all: ng build fe-task && ng build fe-shell
scripts.perf:prepare: npm run build:all && rm -rf dist/lhci && cp -r dist/fe-shell/browser dist/lhci && mkdir -p dist/lhci/remotes/fe-task && cp -r dist/fe-task/browser/. dist/lhci/remotes/fe-task/ && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/lhci/federation.manifest.json', JSON.stringify({ feTask: '/remotes/fe-task/remoteEntry.json' }))"
scripts.perf:lhci: npm run perf:prepare && cd dist && lhci autorun --config=../lighthouserc.json
